description:
Cap table of a German GmbH or UG after a financing round: price per share, shares and percentages before and after (fully diluted and real), convertible loans (cap, discount, floor, interest), VSOP pool top-up, capital increase and Agio, and optionally an exit waterfall with liquidation preference. Free, no key. Each share has a nominal value of 1 €.

Calculate a cap table

Antwortet auf Deutsch, als Text oder JSON. Der Rechner für Menschen: https://www.firma.de/cap-table-rechner/

exit.description: Optional exit waterfall for one exit value.

multiple.description: Liquidation preference as a multiple of what each investor and lender put in; 0 for none.

participating.description: Preferred holders take their preference and then share the rest pro rata.

poolGranted.description: Count the free VSOP pool as granted by the exit.

strike.description: Strike price per virtual share in euros.

value.description: Exit value (price for 100 % of the company). In euros.

format.description: md (Standard): die Antwort als lesbarer Text mit Link in den Rechner, kurz genug für den Chat. json: alle Werte als JSON.

name.description: Optional; numbered from the language otherwise (Founder 1).

shares.description: Geschäftsanteile at 1 € nominal each, so also the founder's Stammkapital in euros.

amount.description: Ticket; the investor gets as many whole shares as it buys. In euros.

name.description: Optional; numbered from the language otherwise (Founder 1).

lang.description: Language of names, messages, Markdown and the calculator link.

loans.description: Convertible loans (Wandeldarlehen) converting in this round.

cap.description: Valuation cap. Null or 0 for none. In euros.

discount.description: Discount on the round price in percent: 20 means 20 %.

floor.description: Valuation floor. Null or 0 for none. In euros.

interestDays.description: Days from payout to conversion; interest runs for these. Alternatively give months.

months.description: Term in months, converted to days as the calculator does (months × 365 ÷ 12).

name.description: Optional; numbered from the language otherwise (Founder 1).

rate.description: Interest in percent per year: 5 means 5 % p.a.

pool.description: The existing VSOP pool before the round, in virtual shares.

poolMode.description: post: everyone, the new investor included, carries the pool top-up. pre: the top-up counts into the pre-money, only existing shareholders carry it.

poolTarget.description: Free pool after the round in percent of all fully diluted shares: 10 means 10 %.

name: cap_table
title: firma.de cap table API
